scope: The 120-floor Jeddah Tower construction snapshot documented in the 2 November 2026 investor release. The exterior includes the tapered wings, exposed structural decks, incomplete window panels, work platforms and cranes.

primaryWrittenSources.facts: Kingdom Holding earnings release on 2 November reports level 120 and approximately 482 m, 3,900 façade panels installed (around 14%) and unfinished works.
Structural engineer confirmed the photographic stage at roughly 100 floors and 400 m on 20 April.
Structural concept uses a continuously tapering three-legged plan and linked reinforced-concrete shear walls.
Architect describes the three-petal plan and tapering wings.
Design team describes a tapered Y plan and triangular shear-wall core with one wing approximately aligned north.
